Applicants with international secondary school leaving certificate über uni-assist 15 July
In general: For the winter semester (WS): by 15 July
Submit application via Please apply via uni-assist.

For all applicants who apply with an international educational qualification (A-Levels, High School Diploma, International Baccalaureate, Feststellungsprüfung or similar), the application is also made via the uni-assist e.V., irrespective of the applicant’s nationality.
University entrance qualification Secondary school leaving certificate in original language and sworn translation (into German or English) with grades and overview of subjects;
Language certificate in German or English, see short description of your degree programme

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' and the OVGU Finance page states 'There are no tuition fees'; the semester fee (329.30 EUR) is not tuition. The December 2026 update of the OVGU fees page gives 329.30 EUR for winter semester 2026/27, while the DAAD programme page says 311.30 EUR; this does not affect the tuition fact (0). Intake: the deadline 15 July is stated without a year for international certificates (uni-assist, winter semester), so it is recorded as a recurring deadline (month 7, day 15); the same page states the general uni-assist deadline 'For the winter semester (WS): by 15 July'. German is not listed as a teaching language: compulsory modules are in English and German is only an optional/elective language plus a required German language course. Academic admission requirement is a university entrance qualification (e.g. Abitur); a Moroccan Baccalauréat is the foreign secondary school leaving certificate, which must be sent in original language with a sworn translation into German or English. English language certificate requirement: the DAAD page names IELTS Academic 6.5, Cambridge English Qualifications B2 First and TOEFL iBT 85; the OVGU university page mentions TOEFL/IELTS only indirectly via the uni-assist page ('TOEFL, IELTS or equivalent language certificate').
